item.title: SC green signal for Assam eviction drive, 5 lakh bighas of forest land under focus
item.description: The State has formed a joint Forest and Revenue committee, issued 15-day notices, and plans large-scale plantation in reclaimed areas

item.title: AASU seeks strong action over Delhi racial slur, demands enforcement of Bezbaruah report
item.description: Union ministers and Northeast Chief Ministers condemn the racial abuse case, while a Delhi court remanded the accused couple to judicial custody till March 11.

item.title: Assam faces 70% rainfall deficit since Nov, 99% since Jan; crops at risk
item.description: Unusually dry winter and rising temperatures raise concerns over rabi crops, tea production, and fruit flowering as climate change signals grow stronger

item.title: Hidden camera recovered from TISS Guwahati hostel, police probe underway
item.description: Students demand accountability after the camera was discovered at Jalukbari campus, while the institute assures full cooperation with police

item.title: New Mizoram law limits customary rights for women marrying outsiders
item.description: The Assembly unanimously amends the Mizo Marriage and Inheritance Act, changing inheritance and ST status norms

item.title: CM Sarma announces Rs 200 Cr dairy plant in Mariani, focus on rural self-reliance
item.description: The proposed facility aims to strengthen milk collection, cooperative networks, and market access while generating new livelihood opportunities

item.title: Tribal bodies oppose NEC’s proposed open-cast coal mining in Tinsukia
item.description: Leaders of the organisations claimed that a No Objection Certificate was obtained during a Tirap Colliery Gaon Panchayat meeting without the knowledge of the people of Saliki village
